Apparently resumes aren't enough anymore.

Now companies want you to come into the office and work for free for a few days... just to prove you're worthy of getting the job.

Because probationary periods apparently weren't humiliating enough.

In this video, we look at the rise of mandatory work trials, why companies are pushing them, and all the psychological tricks that come with them—from sunk cost fallacy and assumed ownership to lowball offers after you've already invested your time.
